blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
NCA are a new type of neural network architecture which enable accurate and robust inference at extremely small model sizes.
Recently, NCA have advanced to become interesting low-resource alternatives to convolution- and attention-based architectures for various tasks such as image analysis, synthetic image generation, and simulation.
The rapid development and increased research interest necessitate a comprehensive review of the emerging technology.
This review provides an overview of the fundamentals of NCA , applications to medical imaging, as well as insights into the state of the art.
We analyze recent modifications to the originally proposed NCA architecture with respect to their efficiency and accuracy.
Furthermore, we review practical applications in real-world scenarios with a focus on medical image analysis, segmentation, classification, registration, depth estimation, and image synthesis.
Finally, we identify several advantages of NCA , research gaps, and conclude with an analysis of future opportunities for NCA in medical applications in confined settings or areas that have particular demands for robustness or efficient data processing.
blocks.zh:
NCA是新型神经网络架构,能够在极小的模型尺寸下进行准确而有力的推论.

由于研究的迅速发展和兴趣的提高,需要对新兴技术进行全面审查。
这项评论概述了NCAA的基本原理、医疗成像的应用以及对最新技术的洞察。
我们从效率和准确性的角度分析最近对最初拟议的国家竞争主管机构结构所作的修改。
此外,我们审查现实世界情景中的实际应用,重点是医疗图像分析、分解、分类、登记、深度估计和图像合成。
最后,我们找出了NCA的几个优点,即研究差距,最后分析了NCA在封闭环境或对稳健性或高效数据处理有特别要求的地区医疗应用的未来机会。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
With the rise of AI ( AI ) in medical image analysis, the research interest in robust deep learning models increases.
Modern ANN ( ANN ) models have achieved remarkable performance, but complex architectures often come at the cost of increasingly large model sizes, which prohibit their application.
Applications in resource-constrained environments, such as edge devices, therefore demand small and robust solutions.
blocks.zh:
随着AI(AI)在医学形象分析中的崛起,对强健的深层学习模型的研究兴趣也随之增加.
现代ANN (ANN) 模型已经取得了出众的性能,但复杂的建筑往往以越来越大的模型大小为代价,这禁止了它们的应用.
因此,在资源受限的环境中,例如边缘设备中的应用需要小型而有力的解决方案。

blocks.en:
Recently, NCA were proposed as a new type of lightweight self-organizing neural network models that can be employed in various image analysis tasks with in resource-constrained settings with special demands to robustness.
Researchers in the medical imaging community acknowledge the potential of NCA being used on small-scale hardware in spatially confined settings, and their robustness against population or manifestation shifts. 医学成像界的研究人员认识到NCAA在空间受限环境中被用在小型硬件上的潜力,以及其对人口或表现变化的强健性。 (Ali等人,2024年;Korevaar等人,2024年;Kalkhof等人,2025年a;Krumb和Mukhopadhyay,2025年),分类 Deutges等人(2024年)、注册(Ranem等人,2024年)或深度估计(Krumb和Mukhopadhyay,2025年)。

blocks.en:
Opposed to CNN- or attention-based models, NCA rely on emergent properties of CA . NCA efficiently trade model size for recurrence (i.e. sequential processing), while often being on par with state-of-the-art models in terms of accuracy ( Kalkhof et al., 2023 ) .
Further, NCA were shown to be invariant to image size ( Kalkhof and Mukhopadhyay, 2023 ) , more robust to certain types of data drift ( Kalkhof et al., 2023 ) , and easier to deploy on edge devices without loss of accuracy ( Krumb and Mukhopadhyay, 2025 ) .
All of these properties make NCA an attractive choice for applications with practical constraints, such as limited memory or increased chance of data drift.

此外,NCA被证明对图像大小(Kalkhof和Mukhopadhyay, 2023年)不具有变化性,对某些类型的数据漂移(Kalkhof等人, 2023年)更强健,更容易在边缘装置上部署而不失去准确性(Krumb和Mukhopadhyay, 2025年)。
所有这些属性都使得NCAA成为具有实际限制的应用程序的有吸引力的选择,例如内存有限或数据漂移的机会增加.

blocks.en:
However, despite all the potential benefits, researchers training NCA for tasks in medical imaging will still face several challenges associated with this relatively young model architecture.
For instance, strategies to reduce computational cost at training time are still being investigated and mainly leverage domain-specific rather than general-purpose optimizations.
Further, a full exploration of best practices is still subject to future research.
A systematic search of suitable practices for NCA model design, application to more downstream tasks (image detection, compression, and others) or data types (sequential data) is still improvable.

例如,在培训时降低计算成本的战略仍在调查之中,主要利用特定领域而不是普通用途优化。

blocks.en:
The increased research interest in NCA over the past six years by both practitioners and theorists reflects in a rising number of papers being published on the topic (Figure 1 ).
Here, we present the first systematic survey of the recent state of the art in the development of NCA , with a focus on their applications in medical imaging.
While Hartl et al. (2026) have recently published a review article on NCA , their literature review focuses on understanding biological pattern formation and self-organization with NCA .
In this paper, we present a comprehensive review of applications of NCA and identify research gaps that are relevant for their practical deployment.

blocks.en:
We first outline our method for systematic literature research, adhering to PRISMA ( PRISMA ) guidelines, in Section 2 .
Further, we describe the fundamental concepts behind NCA to give the reader an idea of the basic architecture, its hyperparameters, possible tweaks and modifications of the architecture in Section 3 .
On that basis, Section 4 introduces a variety of possible applications for which NCA are employed, what challenges were faced, and how they were overcome.
Finally, we discuss the value of NCA for medical imaging and potential opportunities for future research (Section 5 ).

blocks.en:
The key findings of this survey include: • Overall research interest in NCA increases linearly since their formalization by Mordvintsev et al. (2020) . • We observe a tendency of NCA research heading towards medical imaging applications, due to their versatility and small scale.
Medical image analysis is a driving force for NCA developments, as potential tasks, datasets and challenges are exceptionally diverse within this regime. • We identify and exchange ideas from different isolated research streams working on NCA , which are usually overlooked as they use different terminology. • We identify several research gaps in conception , assessment and deployment of NCA for medical image analysis.

blocks.en:

The cut-off point for this search was 31 August 2026.
PubMed yielded 178 entries, of which 171 were considered relevant.
Google Scholar yielded 559 results, of which 149 were considered relevant, whereas Semantic Scholar yielded 107 relevant entries out of 109 entries total.
Apart from a systematic literature review, we further added 7 papers to the pool that we learned about through conferences and conversations with peers.

blocks.en: 2.1 Limitations
blocks.zh: 2.1 限制

blocks.en:
Studying applications and new architectural improvements for NCA is a rapidly growing research field.
Following a general trend that can be observed especially in deep learning and AI , 58 of the research papers are arXiv preprints that have not (yet) undergone peer review.
However, some of the publications presented here are backed by public codebases, making the presented findings reproducible to at least some degree.
We therefore decided to include arXiv papers in our review, but put an emphasis on findings discussed in peer-reviewed papers.

blocks.en: 2.2 NCA Definition
blocks.zh: 2.2 国家竞争主管机构 定义

blocks.en:
We define an NCA as an iterative cellular computation in which each cell maintains a state and updates that state using a local, parameterized update rule.
The update rule may depend on the state of the cell and on information obtained from a defined local neighborhood (the neighborhood must not be the entire image).
At least part of this recurrent cell-update rule must be parameterized by continuous-valued weights that are not constrained to a discrete set.
The same update rule, or rules derived from a shared parameterization, is applied repeatedly across cells and time.
blocks.zh:
我们把NCA定义为一个迭代的细胞计算,每个单元格在计算中维持一个状态并使用一个本地的,参数化的更新规则来更新该状态.
更新规则可能取决于细胞的状态和从定义的本地邻里获得的信息(邻里不能是整个图像).
这个反复出现的单元格更新规则至少有一部分必须用不受离散集限制的连续值加权参数化.
相同的更新规则,或源自共享参数化的规则,在细胞和时间之间反复被应用.

blocks.en:
Cell states may be discrete or continuous and may contain additional persistent latent variables.
The update function need not contain an intermediate hidden representation.
If transient hidden representations are used, these are local and must not be shared with other cells (otherwise the model becomes a recurrent CNN ( CNN )).
Persistent latent variables through which cells communicate are considered part of the cell state.
We impose no restrictions on the topology of the cellular domain, which may be regular or irregular.
blocks.zh:
细胞状态可能是离散的或连续的,可能包含额外的持久性潜在变量.
更新功能不需要包含中间隐藏的表示.
如果使用瞬间隐形表示,这些表示是局部的,不得与其他单元格共享(否则模型会成为经常性CNN(CNN).
细胞通过这些变量进行通信被认为是细胞状态的一部分。
我们对细胞域的地貌没有限制,这种地貌可能是正常的或不正常的.

blocks.en:
Furthermore, we require rollout-aware training.
Each parameter-update step must be based on a rollout containing at least 2 consecutive applications of the NCA update rule.
The state produced by one NCA step must serve as input to the subsequent NCA step, such that the optimization objective depends on the model’s multi-step dynamics rather than exclusively on isolated one-step transitions.
This requirement is independent of the optimization algorithm.
For gradient-based training, the optimization signal must account for the dependency through at least 2 consecutive NCA steps, for example through BPTT ( BPTT ).
For gradient-free training, candidate parameterizations must analogously be evaluated according to an objective computed from a rollout of at least two consecutive NCA steps.
blocks.zh:
此外,我们需要展开认识培训。
每个参数更新步骤必须基于至少包含NCAA更新规则连续两个应用程序的推出.
一个NCAA步骤所产生的状态必须作为对随后NCAA步骤的投入,这样优化目标就取决于模型的多步骤动态,而不是完全依赖于孤立的一步骤过渡.
这一要求独立于优化算法.
对于基于梯度的训练,优化信号必须至少通过连续两个NCAA步骤,例如通过BPTT(BPTT)来考虑依赖性.
对于无梯度培训,必须同样根据至少连续推出两个NCAA步骤所计算的目标来评价候选参数化。

blocks.en: 3 Fundamentals
blocks.zh: 3 基本要素

blocks.en:
The idea of CA was first formalized as a discrete computation model by Neumann (1966) .
Later, John Conway created a practical manifestation of CA , called Conway’s Game of Life ( Gardner, 1970 ) .
Conway and his colleagues tried to investigate how a given initial formation would behave, to little success.
It was later shown that Conway’s Game of Life is in fact Turing complete, and that its halting problem is undecidable.
Since then, CA have been used for modelling differential equations, such as tumor growth dynamics ( Valentim et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh:
CA的构思由Neumann(1966年)首次正式成为离散计算模型.
后来,约翰·康威(John Conway)创立了CA的实际表现,取名"康威的生命游戏"(Gardner,1970).
康威和他的同事试图调查一个特定的初始阵型将如何表现,几乎没有成功.
后来显示康威的"生命之游戏"实际上已经是图灵所完成的了,而其停止的问题是无法确定的.
此后,CA被用于模拟微分方程,如肿瘤生长动力学(Valentim等,2023.

blocks.en:
NCA are a new type of neural architecture that marries the ideas of two bio-inspired systems, by enhancing CA with neural networks.
Typically, NCA work on an image grid with an extended channel dimension, where a common, learned local rule is applied to each of the cells in an iterative fashion.
blocks.zh:
NCAA是一种新型神经架构,通过增强CA与神经网络结合两个生物启发系统的思想.
通常,NCAA工作在具有扩展通道维度的图像网格上,其中以迭代的方式将一个共同的,有学识的局部规则应用于每个单元格.

blocks.en:
A good basis for understanding NCA is the paper (and interactive online demo) by Mordvintsev et al. (2020) , who initially proposed the type of NCA that this review targets.
Prior to their work, which was published in 2020, other algorithms described as ”Neural Cellular Automata” were proposed, but these were often grounded on vastly different concepts ( Boehme et al., 1992 ) .
In the following explanations, we will utilize the terminology and basic architecture described by Mordvintsev et al. (2020) , as it serves as a common ground for most recent works on NCA .
Figure 4 illustrates the interplay of building blocks for our canonical NCA definition.

blocks.en:
An NCA operates on a lattice of cells, iteratively applying a fixed local update rule as in a standard CA framework ( Neumann, 1966 ) .
Each cell state is represented by a C C -dimensional real vector.
We name the entirety of all cells the state , represented by S ∈ ℝ C × H × W \textbf{S}\in\mathbb{R}^{C\times H\times W} where H H and W W are the dimensions of the grid.
The NCA encodes the update rule in a neural network, computing the next state S C × H × W t + 1 \textbf{S}^{t+1}_{C\times H\times W} of time t + 1 t+1 given the previous state S C × H × W t \textbf{S}^{t}_{C\times H\times W} .
The NCA update function can be divided into different components, which we explain separately.
blocks.zh:
NCAA运行在一团一团的单元格上,迭接地应用一个固定的局部更新规则,如标准CA框架(Neumann,1966.).
每个单元格状态由C-维真实向量代表.

NCA在神经网络中编码了更新规则,计算了下一个状态S C × H × W t + 1\textbf{S}^{t+1}_{C\times 时间 时间=t+1t+1,考虑到以前的状态S C× H×W t\textbf{S}^{t}_{C\times H\ttimeW}.
NCAA更新功能可被分为不同的组件,我们对此分别解释.

blocks.en:
Perception: The perception mechanism is responsible for aggregating the states of its neighboring cells.
Specifically, neighborhood values are aggregated separately for each of the C C dimensions as a weighted sum of each neighbor.
Implemented as depthwise convolutions, the weights are either hard-coded as proposed by Mordvintsev et al. (2020) or learned as by Kalkhof et al. (2023) .
At least in the hard-coded perception, multiple aggregation matrices (convolution kernels) are specified, such as Sobel filters in the x- and y-directions or Laplace filters.
Also, the identity of the current cell is preserved and concatenated with the results of the previous neighborhood aggregations.
For n n convolutional kernels, the result is a ( n + 1 ) ⋅ C (n+1)\cdot C -dimensional perception vector for each cell in the grid Z ( n + 1 ) ​ C × H × W t \textbf{Z}^{t}_{(n+1)C\times H\times W} .
There is no general constraint on the number of aggregation matrices, so the perception vectors’ dimensionality can be any multiple of C C .
The perception mechanism is efficiently implemented by a depthwise convolution.

具体来说,邻接值作为每个相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相相邻相相邻相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相
作为深度演化法执行,权重要么按照莫德文采夫等人(2020年)的建议硬编码,要么按照卡尔克霍夫等人(2023年)的建议学习.
至少在硬编码的感知中,指定了多个聚合矩阵(volution 内核),如x-和y-方向或Laplace滤波器中的索贝尔滤波器.
另外,目前细胞的特性也得到了保存并被与之前邻里汇总的结果相配合.
对 n 演化内核,结果为 a (n + 1) + C (n+1)\ cdot C - 网格Z中每个单元格的维感向量(n+1) C× H×W t\textbf{Z}^{t}_{(n+1)C\times H\times W}.
汇总矩阵的数量没有普遍的限制,因此感知向量的维度可以是C的任何倍数.
感知机制通过深度演化得到高效实施.

blocks.en:
Adaptation: The perception vectors are fed through a fully connected neural network.
Usually, the adaptation network consists of 2 linear layers with hidden dimensionality D D and a ReLU ( ReLU ) activation function in between.
The last linear layer projects the latent representation down to the C C -dimensional additive update.
The adaptation network can be efficiently implemented using 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolutions.
blocks.zh:
适应: 知觉向量通过一个完全连接的神经网络来提供.
通常,适应网络由两个有隐藏维度D的线性地层和介于两者之间的活化活化(ReLU)功能组成.
最后一个线性层将潜在代表值投射到C-维添加剂更新.
适应网络可以使用 1×1 1\times 1 演化来高效地实施.

blocks.en:
Stochastic Update: Cells do not update synchronously; instead, depending on the fire rate α ∈ ( 0 , 1 ] \alpha\in(0,1] , update vectors are randomly set to 0 ∈ ℝ C 0\in\mathbb{R}^{C} by probability α \alpha .
The stochastic cell update can be interpreted as a cell-based dropout ( Mordvintsev et al., 2020 ) .
The stochastic update is efficiently implemented by sampling an activation matrix M ∼ Ber ​ ( α ) M\sim\textbf{Ber}(\alpha) from a Bernoulli distribution and multiplying it with the previous output.
Setting α = 1 \alpha=1 results in a deterministic model with synchronous updates.
blocks.zh:
Stochastic Update:单元格不同步更新;取而代之的是,根据起火率 α (0, 1)\alpha\in (0, 1),更新向量被随机设定为 0 → R C 0\in\mathb{ R\C}通过概率 α\alpha 。
斯多克特克特细胞更新可以被解释为基于细胞的退出(Mordvintsev等,2020.
通过对Bernoulli分布的活化基质M → Ber (α) M\sim\textbf{Ber} (\alpha) 进行取样,并将其与上个输出相乘,从而高效地进行分层更新.
设置 α = 1\ alpha = 1 导致一个具有同步更新的定型模型.

blocks.en: Residual Connection: The computed update grid is added to the current state of the cell, introducing an additive residual connection.
blocks.zh: 剩余连接 : 计算出的更新网格被加入到细胞的当前状态中,引入了添加剂的剩余连接.

blocks.en:
Seeding NCA : After initializing the C × H × W C\times H\times W grid with height H H , width W W , and cell dimensionality C C (as above), the grid must be initialized with some information, which may depend on the task.
Hence, for imaging tasks, the state partitions into the image, the output, and hidden dimensions.
In the task of growing images from a single seed, most of the grid can indeed remain empty, but a seed must be placed in the center of the grid to start the computation ( Mordvintsev et al., 2020 ) .
Placing multiple single-pixel seeds can be used to condition the NCA on different shapes, structures, and orientations of the generated pattern ( Randazzo et al., 2023 ) .
If the NCA should compute a result directly depending on the input, the grid is seeded with that specific input.
For example, in image segmentation, the input image is inserted in one of the channels of the initial grid.
The remaining channels of the initial grid can be initialized with zeros or uniform noise ( Pajouheshgar et al., 2024b ) .
blocks.zh:
种子 NCA : 初始化 C × H × W C\times H\times W 的网格有高H H,宽W W,和细胞维度 C C(如上)后,网格必须先初始化一些信息,这可能取决于任务.
因此,对于成像任务来说,状态分区进入了成像,输出,以及隐藏的维度.
在从单一种子中生长图像的任务中,大部分网格确实可以保持空地,但种子必须被放入网格中心以开始计算(Mordvintsev等,2020.
将多颗单像素种子放入可以用来对NCAA进行不同形状,结构,以及生成模式的取向等条件(Randazzo等,2023年).
如果NCAA直接根据输入来计算结果,则网格会以该特定输入为种子.
例如,在图像分割中,输入图像被插入到初始网格的一个通道中.
初始电网的其余通道可以以零或统一噪声来初始化(Pajouheshgar等,2024b.) 。 。 。 。

blocks.en: 3.1 Architectural Variations
blocks.zh: 3.1 建筑变化

blocks.en: Several variations of the original NCA recipe were proposed in follow-up work to Mordvintsev et al. (2020) , some of which are outlined in the following.
blocks.zh: 在Mordvintsev等人(2020年)的后续工作中,提出了NCAA原始配方的几种变种,其中的一些变种概述如下.

blocks.en:
ViTCA: Potentially, the biggest and most prominent change to the standard NCA is the Vision Transformer Cellular Automata (ViTCA), which leverages the idea of cellular automata but replaces the fully connected backbone and neighborhood aggregation with a local transformer operating on the same local Moore neighborhood ( Tesfaldet et al., 2022 ) .
The model was extended to a diffusion transformer ( Elbatel et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh:
ViTCA:潜在的,对标准NCAA的最大和最显著的改变是"VitCA"(VitCA),它利用了"蜂窝自动机"(cell automata)的理念,但将完全连接的骨干和相邻的集合取而代之的是在当地同座摩尔居民区运行的本地变压器(Tesfaldet等,2022年).
该型号被扩展至扩散变压器(Elbatel等,2024.).

blocks.en:
Immutable state channels: Most NCA applied to discriminative tasks initialize the state with the input and keep those state channels immutable.
The first work to incorporate this change is the segmentation NCA by Sandler et al. (2020) .
blocks.zh:
不可改变的州道: 大部分NCAA应用了带有歧视性的任务,以输入方式初始化了州并保持了这些州道的不可改变.
纳入这一变化的第一项工作是Sandler等人(2020年)的分化NCA.

blocks.en: Normalization layers: Some NCA architectures employ normalization layers, such as a global batch norm ( Kalkhof and Mukhopadhyay, 2023 ) employed in the latent space of the NCA feed-forward network (i.e. between the hidden layers). Kalkhof et al. (2024a) employ a cell-wise normalization to adhere to the cell-wise updates of NCA . Tesfaldet et al. (2022) use layer normalization. Other normalization schemes can be used as well.
blocks.zh: 常态化层 : 一些NCAA架构采用了常态分层,如NCAA向导网络(即隐藏分层之间)潜入空间中使用的全球分批规范(Kalkhof and Mukhopadhyay, 2023). Kalkhof等人(2024a)采用细胞常态,以坚持细胞常态更新NCAA。 Tesfaldet等 (2022)使用地层正常化. 其他正常化计划也可以使用。

blocks.en:
Multiplicative Conditioning: Sudhakaran et al. (2022) employ an embedding that is multiplied to the state channels in the NCA grid.
Similarly, Kalkhof et al. (2024a) and Ranem et al. (2025) multiply the embedding to the perception vector and the latent space of the NCA adaptation network.
blocks.zh:
倍数 条件:Sudhakaran等人(2022年)采用嵌入法,并乘以NCAA网格中的州道.
同样,Kalkhof等人(2024年a)和Ranem等人(2025年)使NCAA适应网络的嵌入量和潜在空间倍增。

blocks.en:
μ \mu NCA: Mordvintsev and Niklasson (2021) propose an even smaller NCA architecture consisting of only convolutional kernels, a learnable non-linearity, and a single linear layer projecting the perception vector down to the dimensionality of the cells.
These measures allow shrinking the NCA model to as few as 68 parameters.
blocks.zh:
μ\mu NCAA:莫德文采夫和尼克拉松(2021年)提出更小的NCAA架构,由只有会演化的内核,可学习的非线性,和单线性地层将感知向量投射到细胞的维度上.
这些措施使得NCAA模型缩小到多达68个参数.

blocks.en: Positional encoding: Pajouheshgar et al. (2024b) , Kalkhof et al. (2025b) include a global positional encoding that is appended to the perception vector in each NCA update step. Similarly, ViTCA employs a positional encoding ( Tesfaldet et al., 2022 , Elbatel et al., 2024 )
blocks.zh: 位置编码 : Pajouheshgar等人(2024年b),Kalkhof等人(2025年b)包括一个全球位置编码,该编码附在NCAA每个更新步骤的感知矢量上. 同样,VitCA也使用一种位置编码(Tesfaldet等人,2022年;Elbatel等人,2024年)

blocks.en:
Isotropic / Chiral NCA : Mordvintsev et al. (2022) proposed IsoNCA, an isotropic (rotationally- and mirror-equivariant) NCA by replacing the Sobel filters with a Laplacian filter that satisfies this property.
Later, Randazzo et al. (2023) propose the steerable NCA , which is a chiral (rotationally equivariant, but not mirror-equivariant) NCA architecture.
The steerable NCA automatically infers the rotation of the Sobel filters at each step.
Due to the stochastic nature of NCA , the same NCA may generate different rotations of the same image it was trained on.
blocks.zh:
Isotropic / Chilal NCA : Mordvintsev等 (2022) 提出IsoNCA,一种异构(旋转-和镜-等)NCA,取而代之的是索贝尔滤波器,取而代之的是满足了这个属性的拉普拉斯滤波器.
后来,Randazzo等人(2023年)提出可被引导的NCAA . . . NCAA是一种手性(旋转等式,但并非镜-等式)NCA建筑.
可操纵 NCA 自动推断出索贝尔滤波器在每个步骤的旋转.
由于NCAA的花样特异性,同名NCAA可能会产生与其所训练的同名图像不同的旋转.

blocks.en:
Non-regular input lattice: While the NCA mentioned before operate on a regular 2D or 3D lattice with 8 or 26 neighbors, respectively, NCA can be extended to irregular neighborhoods with a varying number of neighbors as a Graph NCA ( Grattarola et al., 2021 ) .
Similar to the message passing scheme ( You et al., 2020 ) , messages from its neighbors are summed and processed to update each cell’s latent state. Gala et al. (2023) extend upon this early work, including a hidden state for each cell.
Finally, Pajouheshgar et al. (2024a) propose MeshNCA operating on a 2-dimensional manifold mesh for texture generation.
They propose a mesh perception module based on spherical harmonics that extends Laplacian and Sobel filters to non-regular grids.
blocks.zh:
非常规输入网格 : 虽然之前提到的NCA在普通的有8个或26个邻居的2D或3D拉蒂斯上运行,但NCAA可以作为Graph NCA(Grattarola等,2021年)扩展至有不同邻居的非正规街区.
类似消息传递方案(You et al., 2020),其邻居的讯息被汇总和处理,以更新每个单元格的潜在状态。 Gala等(2023年)扩展了这一早期的工作,包括每个细胞的隐藏状态.
最后,Pajouheshgar等人(2024a)提议使用二维多维网格操作来进行纹理生成.
他们提出了基于球形口琴的网状感知模块,将拉普拉琴和索贝尔滤波器延伸至非正格.

blocks.en: ANCA: Most NCA -architectures employ a static cell-lattice, where the spatial position of individual NCA -cells is fixed in relation to the input data. Kvalsund et al. (2026) propose Active NCA (ANCA), an NCA -based image classification architecture that decouples the input-space from the NCA state-space. The authors employ a cell grid that is spatially detached from the input data. Through dedicated channels in the state-space, individual cells can freely control the position of their receptive field in the image-space throughout the inference process.
blocks.zh: ANCA:大多数NCA-architectures使用静态的细胞纬度,其中单个NCA-细胞的空间位置与输入数据相接固定. Kvalsund et al. (2026)提议Active NCA(ANCA),一种基于NCA的图像分类架构,将输入-空间从NCAA状态-空间中脱钩. 作者使用从空间上脱离输入数据的单元格网格. 通过状态-空间的专用通道,单个细胞可以在整个推论过程中自由控制其在图像-空间中接受场的位置.

blocks.en: 3.2 Loss Function and Training of NCAs
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家竞争主管机构的职能丧失和培训

blocks.en:
NCA can be trained using the same loss functions as other neural networks.
Depending on the task (segmentation, classification, regression), common loss functions are (binary) cross-entropy or mean squared/absolute error.
However, cell states must be aggregated for loss computation in tasks that yield a lower-dimensional prediction (e.g. image classification), for instance through average or maximum pooling followed by a fully connected head layer ( Deutges et al., 2024 ) , or a majority vote of all cells ( Döhler et al., 2008 ) .
blocks.zh:
NCA可以使用与其他神经网络相同的损失功能来训练.
根据任务(分级,分级,回归)的不同,常见的损失函数是(二进制)交叉的或指平方/绝对错误.
然而,在产生下维预测(例如图像分类)的任务中,如通过平均或最大集合,然后是完全相连的头层(Deutges等人,2024年),或所有细胞的多数票(Döhler等人,2008年),单元格状态必须加以汇总计算损失。

blocks.en:
Due to the recurrence, NCA are trained by BPTT , which unrolls the computational graph during the forward pass (over time) and accumulates the gradients obtained in each time step.
The unrolled computational graph can become long for a large number of NCA iterations, which renders training slow and puts high demand on the GPU memory.
blocks.zh:
由于重现,NCAA由BPTT 训练,在前传(过后)期间解开计算图并积累每个时段得到的梯度.
未滚动的计算图对于大量的NCAA迭代可能变得很长,这使得训练缓慢并给GPU内存带来高需求.

blocks.en:
Other methods train NCA with gradient-free optimization algorithms, e.g., genetic algorithms ( Döhler et al., 2008 ) .
However, these are exceptions. The preferred way of training NCA is via gradient-based optimization.
blocks.zh:
其他方法用无梯度优化算法训练NCAA,例如遗传算法(Döhler等,2008.).
然而,这些都是例外。 培训国家竞争主管机构的首选方法是通过以梯度为基础的优化。

blocks.en: 3.3 Relationship to Common Neural Models
blocks.zh: 3.3 与共同神经模型的关系

blocks.en: Figure 5: Relationship of common neural architectures to NCA models. 1 : CNN-type models may operate locally if they are shallow.
blocks.zh: 图5:常见神经架构与NCAA模型的关系. 1:有线电视新闻网型号的型号若为浅水可在当地运行.

blocks.en:
Although NCA make use of convolutions and neural networks, the approach is still rather different from that of CNN .
Typically, CNN -based architectures like ResNet ( He et al., 2016 ) are much larger than NCA models, and they have been shown to have high parameter redundancy ( Denil et al., 2013 ) , whereas NCA weights are usually more compact.
While CNN operate in a single forward pass, NCA apply multiple forward passes utilizing the same set of filters. Mordvintsev et al. (2020) describe NCA as ”Recurrent Residual Convolutional Networks with ‘per-pixel’ Dropout” .
blocks.zh:
虽然NCAA使用进化和神经网络,
一般情况下,有线电视新闻网(ResNet (He等,2016年))等基于CNN的架构比NCAA模型大得多,而且它们已被证明具有高参数冗余(Denil等,2013年),而NCAA的权重通常更为紧凑.
虽然有线电视新闻网以单一前行通道运行,但NCAA使用同一套滤波器应用多条前行通道. 莫德文采夫等(2020年)将NCAA描述为"具有"每像素"的再现残余革命网络".

blocks.en:
ViT and ViTCA models exhibit the same differences that exist between CNN and NCA .
The ViTCA is iterated multiple times, utilizing the same set of parameters.
Similar to the description for NCA, ViTCA can be seen as a recurrent convolutional transformer with ’per-pixel’ Dropout.
blocks.zh:
VIT和VITCA模型显示出CNN和NCAA之间存在的相同差异.
VITCA采用同一套参数被多次重复使用.
与NCAA的描述类似,VitCA可被看做是一个与"per-pixel" Dropout相伴的反复回转变压器.

blocks.en: Figure 5 shows the similarities and differences of NCA with other established deep learning architectures.
blocks.zh: 图5显示了NCAA与其他已确立的深层学习架构的相似性和差异.

blocks.en: 3.4 Composite NCA architectures
blocks.zh: 3.4 综合净捐助国结构

blocks.en:
While a single NCA already proves capable of solving different tasks, some methods combine multiple NCA , potentially with other architectures, to create an even more expressive model.
Multiple NCA can be applied sequentially at increasing resolutions to create a model scalable to high-resolution training data ( Kalkhof et al., 2023 , Kalkhof and Mukhopadhyay, 2023 ) . Yue et al. (2024) and Menta et al. (2024) embed an NCA in a UNet-style autoencoder architecture.
The NCA performs the computation at the autoencoder’s bottleneck.
The remaining layers are responsible for down- and upscaling the input and output of the NCA . Xu et al. (2024) include an NCA in a vision transformer operating directly on a grid of tokens. The NCA improves the model’s robustness to noisy images and adversarial attacks.
blocks.zh:
虽然一个单一的NCAA已经证明能够解决不同的任务,但有些方法结合了多个NCAA,有可能与其他架构,以创造一个更加表现的模型.
多个NCA可以相继应用来增加分辨率来创建可扩展至高分辨率培训数据的模型(Kalkhof等,2023年;Kalkhof和Mukhopadhyay,2023年). 岳等 (2024)和门塔等. (2024)将NCA嵌入了UNet风格的自编码器架构.
NCA在自动编码器的瓶颈处进行计算。
其余各层负责下调和提升NCAA的输入和输出. 徐等(2024年)将一款NCA包括在一款直接运行于地标网的视变器中. NCAA提升了模型的稳健性,

blocks.en: 3.5 Related concepts and other names of NCA
blocks.zh: 3.5 国家竞争主管机构的相关概念和其他名称

blocks.en:
There are several related concepts to NCA .
Some concepts share similarities with NCA , even fitting our definition in Section 2.2 , but utilizing a different name, while others do not fit our definition, despite being very close.
Here, we review those concepts.
Tab. 1 lists those methods and their main differences from NCA .
blocks.zh:
与NCAA有一些相干的概念。
有些概念与NCAA有相似之处, 即使我们的定义在第2.2节,
在这里,我们审查这些概念。
标签1列出了这些方法及其与NCAA的主要区别。

blocks.en:
CA and probabilistic CA use hand-engineered rules, while the latter also implements a probability distribution over state transitions.
The probabilistic CA is also referred to as Markov-CA ( Markov-CA ), Markov Chain CA , CA-Markov , and CA-MC .
blocks.zh:
CA和概率CA使用手动规则,而后者也执行在状态过渡上的概率分布.
概率CA也被称为"马尔可夫-CA"(Markov-CA),"马尔可夫链CA","CA-马尔可夫"和"CA-MC".

blocks.en:
While CLA ( CLA ) ( Beigy and Meybodi, 2004 ) sounds related to NCA , their concepts are rather different.
In CLA , each cell has its own set of rules.
So, instead of learning a shared rule, each cell optimizes its own rule.
blocks.zh:
虽然CLA (CLA) (Beigy and Meybodi, 2004) 听起来与NCAA有关,
在CLA,每个细胞都有自己的一套规则.
因此,每个细胞与其学习共享规则,不如优化自己的规则.

blocks.en:
The idea of ANN-CA ( ANN-CA ) ( Li and Yeh, 2002b ) is somewhat similar to that of NCA , as it combines a neural network with a CA .
However, the neural network is trained only for a single CA transition.
Only after training is the ANN embedded into the CA to enable longer rollouts.
Subsequently, ANN-CA does not have hidden states, and the output is always a discrete variable (not warranted by our definition).
The ANN-CA exhibits high popularity in LULC ( LULC ) modeling ( Zhang and Liao, 2024 , Daich et al., 2025 , Otmane Cherif et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
ANN-CA(英语:ANN-CA (Ann-CA) (Li and Yeh, 2002 b))的想法与NCAA有些相似,因为它结合了神经网络和CA.
然而,神经网络只接受单一CA过渡的培训.
只有经过培训后,ANN才被嵌入到CA中,以便能够更长时间地展开.
随后,ANN-CA没有隐藏状态,输出总是一个离散的变量(我们的定义不支持).
ANN-CA在LULC(LULC)模特中表现出了很高的受欢迎程度(张和辽,2024年;Daich等,2025年;Otmane Cherif等,2026年).

blocks.en:
ANN-CA-MC ( ANN-CA-MC ) ( Gharaibeh et al., 2020 ) combines the ANN-CA with a Markov chain stage.
The Markov chain estimates pairwise class transition probabilities and converts them into a target number of cells to convert per class pair at each CA step.
The ANN-CA component independently produces a per-cell transition-potential score.
Subsequently, the scores are ranked by this score and converted until the Markov-derived quota is met.
blocks.zh:
ANN-CA-MC (ANN-CA-MC)(Gharaibeh等,2020年)将ANN-CA与马可夫链相融合.
马尔可夫链估计成对类过渡概率,并转换成一个目标数的细胞,在每个CA步骤上转换出每类对.
ANN-CA组件独立产生每个细胞的过渡-潜力分数.
随后,分数按此分数进行排名并进行转换,直至达到马尔可夫衍生的分数.

blocks.en:
The LSTM-CA ( LSTM-CA ) ( Liu et al., 2021 , Rezaie et al., 2026 ) is another model from the LULC direction.
It integrates an LSTM ( LSTM ) module into the ANN-CA .
An LSTM model is trained on the temporal evolution of its state and those of its neighbors.
After learning, the LSTM is deployed in a CA .
No cell-to-cell communication is learned.
Each cell aggregates only the input variables from its neighbors.
blocks.zh:
LSTM-CA (LSTM-CA)(Liu等,2021年;Rezaie等,2026年)是LULC方向上的另一个型号.
它将一个LSTM(LSTM)模块整合到ANN-CA中.
一个LSTM模型接受了关于其状态和邻国状态时间演变的培训.
学习后,LSTM部署在CA.
没有细胞间的交流是学到的。
每个单元格只汇总其相邻的输入变量.

blocks.en:
ACAN ( ACAN ) ( Matsubara and Torikai, 2013 ) is a single neuron that implements a transition function with learned parameters.
The ACAN is optimized via a gradient-free hill-climbing algorithm over the entire trajectory.
However, as it is a single neuron, the neuron is not embedded in a topology but rather works in isolation.
The ACAN is more similar to a recurrent neuron.
blocks.zh:
ACAN (ACAN) (Matsubara and Torikai, 2013)是一单神经元,执行有所学参数的过渡功能.
ACAN通过整个轨迹上无梯度的山地攀登算法得到优化.
然而,由于它是一个单一的神经元,所以神经元并不是嵌入于地貌中,而是在孤立中工作.
ACAN更类似于反复出现的神经元.

blocks.en:
ANCAN ( ANCAN ) ( Matsubara and Torikai, 2016 ) implements multiple ACAN in fixed a topology to build a neural network.
Rather than encapsulating the input (e.g., an image, connectivity graph), the topology represents connectivity in the neural network structure.
While this architecture works substantially different to NCA by generating the prediction over space (from input neurons to output neurons), rather than over time, this architecture does fit out NCA definition.
Since ACAN neurons change values over time, the ANCAN predictions also emerge over time, rather than after a fixed time, as in a conventional neural network.
blocks.zh:
ANCAN(ANCAN)(松原和托里凯,2016年)在固定地貌中执行多个ACAN来构建神经网络.
与封装输入(例如一幅图像,连通图)相反,地貌代表了神经网络结构中的连通性.
虽然这种架构通过在空间上产生预测(从输入神经元到输出神经元)而与NCAA有很大不同,而不是随着时间的推移,但这种架构确实适合NCAA的定义.
由于ACAN神经元随时间而改变值,ANCAN的预测也随时间而出现,而不是像常规神经网络那样在固定时间后出现.

blocks.en:
Cellular Neural Network (CNN, not to be confused with Convolutional Neural Network ) ( Chua and Yang, 1988 , Döhler et al., 2008 ) matches our NCA definition cleanly.
It consists of 2 state channels (1 input and 1 output).
The learned update rule is parameterized by 19 parameters.
The CNN is optimized with a genetic algorithm over 50 rollout steps.
The final classification score is obtained by majority vote of all cells.
blocks.zh:
细胞神经网络(CNN,不可与"同源"神经网络相混淆) . (Chua and Yang, 1988, Döhler等人,2008年)与我们的NCAA定义完全一致.
它由2个州道(1个输入和1个输出)组成.
所学更新规则有19个参数参数.
CNN的基因算法优化了 50多个推出步骤.
最终分类分数由所有细胞的多数票获得.

blocks.en:
Omija et al. (2026) already realized the structural similarity between ConvLSTM ( ConvLSTM ) ( Shi et al., 2015 ) and NCA . ConvLSTM is a convolutional LSTM .
Instead of a simple MLP ( MLP ), the update network uses an advanced LSTM architecture with specific memory management gates.
The hidden state representation of the LSTM is shared with its local neighborhood.
blocks.zh:
Omija等人(2026年)已经意识到ConvLSTM(ConvLSTM)之间的结构相似性. (Shi等,2015年)和NCAA. ConvLSTM是一个革命性的LSTM。
更新网络不用简单的MLP(MLP),而是使用具有特定内存管理门的高级LSTM架构.
LSTM的隐蔽国家代表处与它的当地邻居共享.

blocks.en: Table 1: Other related concepts and their major differences from NCA . Concepts are classified into whether they are an NCA or not as warranted by our definition (Sec. 2.2 ).
blocks.zh: 表1:其他相关概念及其与国家竞争主管机构的主要差异 概念按我们的定义(第2.2节),分为是否为国家竞争主管机构。

blocks.en: 3.6 NCAs on small-scale and specialized hardware
blocks.zh: 3.6 关于小型和专门硬件的国家竞争主管机构

blocks.en:
Thanks to their decreased number of parameters and good balance between model size and accuracy, NCAs have gained attention by researchers investigating deployment on embedded platforms.
Successful deployment of NCA was reported on single-board computers (Raspberry Pi, smartphones), and even on microcontroller hardware ( ESP32-S3 ).
Further, experimental approaches for creating self-organizing cellular devices exist.
blocks.zh:
由于参数数量减少,且模型大小和准确性之间保持了良好的平衡,NCAA得到了研究嵌入式平台部署的研究人员的注意.
据报告,单板计算机(Raspberry Pi,智能手机)甚至微控制器硬件(ESP32-S3 )上成功部署了NCAA。
此外,还存在建立自组织手机装置的实验方法。

blocks.en:
In most of these scenarios, no additional pruning or dedicated techniques for model size reduction had to be employed, delivering similar accuracy to a PC-scale deployment.
However, the maximum input image size is a bottleneck for deployment on embedded platforms which are often memory-constrained.
Table 2 shows a comparison of different NCA implementations on various embedded hardware platforms, which will be detailed in the following:
blocks.zh:
在这些设想中,大多数情况下,不需要采用额外的推算或专用技术来缩小模型尺寸,其精确度与个人计算机的部署相似。
然而,最大输入图像大小是部署在嵌入式平台上的瓶颈,这些平台往往受到内存限制.
表2对各种嵌入式硬件平台上不同的NCAA实施进行了比较,详情如下:

blocks.en: Table 2: Works that present NCA on different embedded hardware platforms. ”Train” indicates whether training is also carried out on the small-scale platform, or only the inference code is ported.
blocks.zh: 表2:在不同嵌入式硬件平台上呈现NCAA的作品. “Train”表示培训是否也在小规模平台上进行,还是只移植了推断码。

blocks.en:
Single-board computers: NCA were successfully deployed for inference on single-board computers such as the Raspberry Pi Kalkhof et al. (2023) , Kalkhof and Mukhopadhyay (2023) , Lemke et al. (2025a) . Kalkhof et al. (2023) demonstrated an NCA for 320 × 320 320\times 320 pixels slice-wise MRI ( MRI ) segmentation
on a Raspberry Pi (1st generation) B+ with a 1 GHz single-core SoC and 512 MB RAM.
In their experiment, inference takes roughly 30 minutes, compared to few seconds on consumer-grade GPU hardware.
blocks.zh:
单板计算机:NCA被成功部署,用于单板计算机的推论,如Raspberry Pi Kalkhof等 (2023), Kalkhof和Mukhopadhyay (2023), Lemke等 (2025a). 卡尔克霍夫等. (2023) 320 × 320 320\times 320像素切入磁共振(核磁共振)分解
由Raspberry Pi(第1代)所组成的B+,具有1GHz单核索克和512MB内存.
在他们的实验中,推论大约需要30分钟,而消费者级GPU硬件的推论需要几秒钟.

blocks.en:
Smartphones: Smartphones are ubiquitous hardware, and they are even available in resource-constrained environments.
This makes them particularly interesting for point-of-care image analysis Kalkhof et al. (2024b) or larger-scale federated learning Lemke et al. (2025b) , enabled by NCA .
blocks.zh:
智能手机: 智能手机是无所不在的硬件,甚至可以在资源受限的环境下提供.
这使得它们对于护理点图像分析Kalkhof等人(2024年b)或NCAA允许的更大规模联合学习Lemke等人(2025年b)特别有趣。

blocks.en: Nunn and Nikoubin (2026) report an inference speed of 3.7 ms 3.7\text{\,}\mathrm{ms} on a Moto G Stylus 5G 2023 smartphone.
blocks.zh: Nunn和Nikoubin(2026年)报告,在Moto G Stylus 5G 2023智能手机上,推论速度为3.7ms 3.7\text~,}\-mathrm{ms}.

blocks.en:
Whereas most approaches concern with inference on mobile devices, Kalkhof et al. (2024b) train NCA on smartphones for 2D X-ray segmentation.
The implementation leveraged TensorFlow Lite for mobile deployment.
Depending on the smartphone model, training may take between 38 to 82 hours total ( 91.2 s 91.2\text{\,}\mathrm{s} to 196.8 s 196.8\text{\,}\mathrm{s} per epoch at 1500 epochs).
However, the presented approach allows for efficient unsupervised site-specific finetuning, which roughly takes 5 to 12 hours total.
The study focused particularly on affordable and refurbished Android smartphones.
blocks.zh:
大多数办法都涉及对移动设备的推论,而Kalkhof等人(2024年b)则在智能手机上对NCAA进行2D X射线分解培训。
执行工作利用了TensorFlow Lite进行流动部署。
视智能手机模式而定,培训总共可能需要38至82小时(91.2 s 9.1.2\text ~,}\-mathrm{s}到196.8 s 196.8\text →,}\-mathrm{s}每个世纪1500个epocres).
然而,所介绍的方法允许对具体地点进行高效的无监督微调,总共大约需要5至12小时。
该研究尤其侧重于负担得起的和翻新的Android智能手机。

blocks.en:
Federated learning approaches manage to relax the computational requirements on smartphones through decentralization, allowing to train NCA on edge devices in a distributed topology Lemke et al. (2025b) .
The proposed setup takes less than 2.5 s 2.5\text{\,}\mathrm{s} per epoch on a single node.
blocks.zh:
联邦学习方法通过权力下放设法放松了智能手机的计算要求,从而得以在分布式地貌Lemke等人(2025年b)中就边缘设备培训NCAA。
提议的设置在一个节点上每个节点需要不到2.5 s 2. 5\text ~, }\ mathrm{s}.

blocks.en:
Microcontrollers: Krumb and Mukhopadhyay (2025) propose NCA for capsule endoscopic segmentation and depth estimation, which are ported to the ESP32-S3 microcontroller.
An optimized inference loop and SIMD ( SIMD ) instructions reduce inference time from 9 s 9\text{\,}\mathrm{s} to 3 s 3\text{\,}\mathrm{s} per image.
The implementation makes use of the ESP32-S3’s floating point unit, meaning that no quantization needs to be applied for deployment on microcontroller hardware.
blocks.zh:
微控制器:Krumb和Mukhopadhyay(2025年)提议将NCA用于胶囊内视分解和深度估计,并移植到ESP32-S3微控制器上.
一个优化的推论回路和SIMD(SIMD)指令将推论时间从每个图像的9 s 9\text~,}\-mathrm{s}减少到3 s 3\text~,}\-mathrm{s}.
实施时使用了ESP32-S3的浮点单元,这意味着不需要在微控制器硬件上应用定量来进行部署.

blocks.en:
Walker et al. (2022) propose an NCA based on physical hardware tiles, each of which is a PCB ( PCB ) with an Arduino Mega 2560.
These hardware tiles communicate to their adjacent tiles via UART in order to aggregate their physical neighborhood for self-classification.
The authors deploy an NCA rule for digit classification and physically align the tiles in digit shapes which are then classified.
The authors suggest that this idea of shape-awareness could be useful for automatic damage detection of complex structures.
blocks.zh:
Walker等人(2022年)提议基于物理硬件瓦片的NCAA,每个瓦片为带有Arduino Mega 2560的PCB(PCB).
这些硬件瓦片通过UART与相邻的瓦片通信,以集聚其物理相邻区域进行自分类.
作者运用了NCAA规则进行数字分类,并将瓷砖以数字形状对齐,然后加以分类。
作者们建议,这种对形状认识的观念对于自动探测复杂结构的损坏可能有用.

blocks.en:
Photonic Circuits: Li et al. (2024) propose a PNN ( PNN ) implementation of an NCA .
To our knowledge, this is the first (and so far only) implementation of NCA in analog hardware.
The proposed in-silico setup is capable of training and inference, and is validated on FashionMNIST ( 99.3 % 99.3\% reported test set accuracy).
blocks.zh:
光学 电路:Li等人(2024年)提议实施NCAA。
据我们所知,这是NCAA在模拟硬件中的首次(迄今为止也是唯一一次)实施.
拟议的西里科内置装置能够进行培训和推论,并且通过FashionMNIST(99.3%的99.3%报告的测试装置精度)验证。

blocks.en: Efficient GPU implementations: General-purpose deep learning frameworks like PyTorch or tensorflow do not necessarily yield the best-performing NCA implementation, especially since these frameworks are optimized for layer-wise inference. Lemke et al. (2025a) propose a custom CUDA kernel for OctreeNCA, which performs cell-wise (rather than layer-wise) inference, therefore reducing VRAM ( VRAM ) requirements significantly.
blocks.zh: 高效的GPU执行:PyTorch或收分流等通用深层学习框架不一定产生最佳的NCAA执行,特别是因为这些框架被优化为分层推论. Lemke等人(2025a)为OctreeNCA提出自定义的CUDA内核,进行细胞(而不是分层)推论,从而大大减少了VRAM(VRAM)的要求.

blocks.en: Another approach, μ \mu NCA, was described earlier in this paper (Section 3.1 ), Mordvintsev and Niklasson (2021) . μ ​ N ​ C ​ A \mu NCA reduces overall NCA complexity by simplifying the nonlinearity and thus reducing parameter count, allowing for a concise and efficient implementation as a fragment shader (demo: https://www.shadertoy.com/view/7cXSDX ).
blocks.zh: 文件(第3.1节)前文已介绍了另一种方法:μ\mu NCA,Mordvintsev和Niklasson(2021年)。 μ N C A\mu NCA通过简化非线性,从而减少参数数来减少NCAA的整体复杂性,从而能够简洁而高效地作为碎片阴影执行(demo:https://www.shadertoy.com/view/7cXSDX)。

blocks.en:
NCA as Digital Circuits: Miotti et al. (2025) propose DiffLogic CA , which are NCA leveraging DLGN as their update rule.
The authors identify the potential for utilizing DLGN in order to create an efficient implementation of NCA for FPGA or ASIC .
blocks.zh:
NCA作为数字电路:Miotti等(2025年)提出DiffLogic CA. NCA利用DLGN作为其更新规则.
作者确定了利用DLGN的潜力,以便高效地实施FPGA或ASIC的NCAA。

blocks.en: However, the logic gate configuration can also be modelled as a self-organizing system akin to NCA . Béna et al. (2026) propose a setup with logic gates that change states based on neighborhood configurations, yielding self-assembling and self-healing digital circuits.
blocks.zh: 然而,逻辑门配置也可以被模拟为类似于NCAA的自组织系统. 贝纳等. (2026)提议设置有逻辑门,以邻里配置为基础来改变状态,产生自组装和自愈的数字电路.

blocks.en:
Self-recognizing Cellular Devices: A fundamental idea for the development of CA was the universal constructor designed by John von Neumann in the 1940s Neumann (1966) , as a prototype model for self-assembling, self-reproducing or self-repairing devices.
This idea reflects in recent work on self-recognizing cellular physical devices based on microcontroller hardware.
In-silico simulators and visualizations are proposed, such as Woiwode et al. (2025) .
A physical approach was demonstrated in hardware for simple 2D shapes (digits) by Walker et al. (2022) . Moreno et al. (2026) propose a hardware design for 3D self-recognizing hardware bricks, and conduct extensive simulation studies demonstrating abilities to self-classify and self-heal complex 3D structures.
Related studies investigate the potentials of NCA for self-repairing soft robots in computer simulations Horibe et al. (2021) , Horibe et al. (2022) .
blocks.zh:
自识别的手机设备 : 开发CA的一个基本思想是约翰·冯·诺伊曼于1940年代(1966年)所设计的通用构造器,作为自组装,自发再生或自修装置的原型.
这一想法反映在最近关于基于微控制器硬件的自识别细胞物理设备的工作上.
In-silico模拟器和可视化被提出,例如Woiwode等 (2025).
由Walker等人(2022年)在硬件中为简单的2D形状(数字)演示出物理方法. 莫雷诺等. (2026)提议为3D自识别硬件砖进行硬件设计,并进行广泛的模拟研究,展示自我分类和自愈复合3D结构的能力.
相关研究调查NCA在计算机模拟Horibe等(2021),Horibe等(2022)中自我修复软机器人的潜力.

blocks.en: 4 Applications of NCAs
blocks.zh: 4 国家竞争主管机构的申请

blocks.en: Table 3: Overview of works utilizing NCAs for medical image analysis
blocks.zh: 表3:利用国家医疗诊断机构进行医疗图像分析的工程概况

blocks.en:
In this section, we review popular application areas and the value provided by the NCA in contrast to other model architectures.
We review NCA for several medical image analysis tasks, robotics, simulation, and image and texture generation.
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们回顾了流行的应用领域以及NCAA相对于其他模型架构所提供的价值.
我们检讨NCA, 用于一些医学图像分析任务,机器人,模拟,图像和纹理生成。

blocks.en: 4.1 Medical Image Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.1 医疗图像分析

blocks.en:
In this section, we present various works that utilize NCA for different medical image analysis tasks.
Medical image analysis is dominated by large convolution- or transformer-based architectures achieving impressive quality across a wide range of applications and anatomies.
These methods already pose great value for the healthcare sector.
However, the ability to solve tasks accurately is not the only concern in medical imaging.
Specifically, proper resource efficiency, robustness, and out-of-distribution handling are at least equally important for medical applications.
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们介绍了利用NCAA从事不同医疗图像分析任务的各种作品.
医学图像分析以大型的以转录或变压器为主的建筑为主,在广泛的应用和解剖中实现了令人印象深刻的质量.
这些方法已经对保健部门产生了很大价值。
然而,准确解决任务的能力并不是医学成像中唯一的关注.
具体而言,适当的资源使用效率、稳健性和分配外处理对于医疗申请至少同样重要。

blocks.en:
As the expressiveness of NCA emerges only from local interactions, the model is inherently invariant to image properties such as size and scaling factor ( Kalkhof and Mukhopadhyay, 2023 ) .
Also, NCA are robust to imaging artifacts Kalkhof et al. (2023) , while the NQM ( NQM ) provides an easy way to detect critical model failure ( Kalkhof and Mukhopadhyay, 2023 ) .
The hidden channels of the NCA provide an easy way for explainability ( Deutges et al., 2024 ) .
Last, the minimal architecture of NCA is parameter-efficient and lightweight, enabling training and inference on minimal hardware such as Raspberry Pis ( Kalkhof and Mukhopadhyay, 2023 ) and microcontrollers ( Krumb and Mukhopadhyay, 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
由于NCAA的表达性仅从局部相互作用中出现,该模型对像大小和缩放因子等图像属性具有内在的不相干性(Kalkhof and Mukhopadhyay, 2023.
另外,NCA对文物的成像能力强于Kalkhof等人(2023年),而NQM(NQM)则提供了检测关键模型故障的简单方法(Kalkhof和Mukhopadhyay,2023年).
NCAA的隐蔽渠道为解释性提供了简单的方法(Deutges等,2024.).
最后,NCAA的最低架构是参数高效和轻量级的,能够对Raspberry Pis(Kalkhof和Mukhopadhyay,2023年)和微控制器(Krumb和Mukhopadhyay,2025年)等最低硬件进行培训和推论.

blocks.en:
All these properties of NCA provide value for medical image analysis beyond great task-solving capabilities.
To this date, NCA have been explored on a variety of tasks and evaluated on different anatomies.
Table 3 provides an overview of various works and respective downstream tasks in medical imaging.
blocks.zh:
NCAA的所有这些特性为医疗图像分析提供了价值,超出了巨大的任务解决能力.
至今,NCAA已就各种任务进行了探索,并对不同的解剖学进行了评估.
表3概述了医学成像中的各种作品和相应的下游任务.

blocks.en: 4.1.1 Medical Image Segmentation
blocks.zh: 4.1.1 医疗图像分解

blocks.en:
Medical image segmentation describes the task of delineating anatomical or pathological regions in a medical image.
In most of the recent works, medical images are segmented per-pixel or per-voxel in a binary or multi-label setting.
Such segmentations can be used for visualization purposes, to determine the size of pathologies, or for creating digital twins of patients for surgical planning ( Krumb et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
医学影像分解描述在医学影像中分解解解剖或病理区域的任务.
在大多数近期的作品中,医学影像在二进制或多标签设定中被分出每像素或每伏克塞尔.
此类分解可用于可视化目的,确定病理大小,或用于为外科规划而创建患者数位双胞胎(Krumb等,2026.

blocks.en:
The nnUnet framework ( Isensee et al., 2021 ) , which leverages the UNet architecture at its core ( Ronneberger et al., 2015 ) , can be deemed the current gold standard for data-driven medical image segmentation.
Typically, without employing techniques like pruning or quantization, the segmentation models trained by nnUnet reach sizes of several hundred Megabytes.
blocks.zh:
nnUnet框架(Isensee等,2021年),以UNet架构为核心的杠杆(Ronneberger等,2015年),可被视作目前数据驱动的医学影像分解的金本位.
通常情况下,不采用诸如打分或量化等技术,nNUnet所训练的分区模型就达到了几百兆字节的大小.

blocks.en:
The first image segmentation algorithm based on NCA was developed by Sandler et al. (2020) .
They use an NCA to segment the foreground object in animal photos of resolution 96 × 96 96\times 96 . As mentioned in Sec. 3.1 , they proposed leaving the input image immutable in the NCA state. They also developed a reset component, which was not adopted in later works. While this method laid the foundation for discriminative modeling with NCA , training was inherently difficult, as it required many steps to transfer global knowledge, resulting in memory requirements that exceeded the limits of recent GPU .
This made the entire method unscalable for more complex tasks and high-resolution data. Med-NCA ( Kalkhof et al., 2023 ) solves those issues by proposing a two-stage NCA architecture.
A first NCA transfers global knowledge at 1 / 4 1/4 of the original spatial resolution.
The states are upscaled and concatenated with the high-resolution image.
The second NCA predicts the final segmentation at the full resolution. During training, the high-resolution NCA is trained on random patches to further reduce the VRAM requirements (see Fig. 6 ). Afterwards, it is applied to the full-scale image.
blocks.zh:
第一个基于NCAA的图像分解算法由Sandler等人(2020年)开发.
他们使用NCA来分解第96×96 96\times 96号决议的动物照片中的前方天体. 如第3.1节所提及,他们提议将输入图像留在NCAA州,不可改变。 他们还开发了重置组件,后期的作品没有采用. 虽然这种方法为与NCAA建立歧视性模式奠定了基础,但培训本身就很困难,因为它要求采取许多步骤来传授全球知识,导致内存要求超过了最近的GPU的限制.
这使得整个方法对于更复杂的任务和高分辨率的数据是无法被扩展的. Med-NCA(Kalkhof等,2023年)通过提出两阶段NCAA架构来解决这些问题.
第一个NCAA以原空间分辨率的1/4 1/4传输全球知识.
各州与高清相像相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接.
第二所NCAA预测最终分解在完全解析. 在训练期间,高分辨NCAA接受随机补丁训练以进一步减少VRAM要求(见图6. 之后,它被应用于全尺寸图像.

blocks.en: Figure 6: By randomly cropping on the high-resolution layers during training, MED-NCA enables training NCAs on large image sizes.
blocks.zh: 图6:在培训期间,MED-NCA通过在高分辨层上随机裁剪,使NCAA能够进行大型图像尺寸的培训.

blocks.en: The architecture was further improved to utilize a variable number of NCA and adapted to 3D segmentation in M3D-NCA ( Kalkhof and Mukhopadhyay, 2023 ) (illustrated in Fig. 7 ).
blocks.zh: 该架构得到进一步改进,以利用数量可变的NCAA,并适应了M3D-NCA(Kalkhof和Mukhopadhyay,2023年)(在图7中缩写)的3D分化.

blocks.en: Figure 7: Passing information over multiple scales accelerates information flow in NCAs.
blocks.zh: 图7:通过多个尺度传递信息可加速国家竞争主管机构的信息流动。

blocks.en:
To stabilize the training of the non-deterministic NCA , they utilize batch duplication.
Following the success of M3D-NCA ( Kalkhof and Mukhopadhyay, 2023 ) , interest in NCA for medical image segmentation increased, with more sophisticated or specialized works following.
blocks.zh:
为了稳定对非决定性的NCAA的培训,它们利用批量重复。
M3D-NCA(Kalkhof and Mukhopadhyay, 2023年)成功后,对NCAA医疗图像分解的兴趣增加,随后是更精密或专业的作品.

blocks.en: Yue et al. (2024) propose a different approach to solving the VRAM and convergence issues of NCAs when applied to high-resolution data. Specifically, they combine NCA with a shallow UNet. While the UNet performs up- and down-scaling of the input/output, the NCA is embedded in the UNet’s latent space, performing the actual segmentation.
blocks.zh: 岳等编. (2024)在应用到高分辨率数据时,提出了解决国家竞争主管机构的VRAM和趋同问题的不同方法. 具体来说,它们结合了NCAA和浅的UNet. 虽然UNet对投入/产出进行上下缩放,但NCAA嵌入了UNet的潜在空间,进行实际分解.

blocks.en: MedSegDiffNCA ( Mittal et al., 2025 ) is a discriminative generative model that performs medical image segmentation using a diffusion model ( Wu et al., 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 梅德塞格-迪夫NCA (Mittal等,2025年)是一种带有歧视性的基因模型,使用扩散模型进行医学图像分解(Wu等,2024年).

blocks.en: Lemke et al. (2025a) extend the M3D-NCA ( Kalkhof and Mukhopadhyay, 2023 ) , leveraging 5 5 NCAs applied in a sequence, each on a different scale. This scheme further reduces VRAM demands, increases runtime efficiency, and slightly improves segmentation quality.
blocks.zh: Lemke等 (2025a) 扩展了M3D-NCA(Kalkhof and Mukhopadhyay, 2023),利用5个按顺序应用的NCAA,每个NCAA的规模不同. 这个方案会进一步降低VRAM的需求,提高运行时间效率,并会略微地提高分区质量.

blocks.en: Lemke et al. (2025b) propose FedNCA, a federated learning scheme based on Med-NCA Kalkhof et al. (2023) . They highlight how FedNCA achieves similar segmentation accuracy to UNets ( Ronneberger et al., 2015 ) and TransUNets Chen et al. (2021a) , but with significantly lower communication costs.
blocks.zh: Lemke等 (2025b)提议FedNCA,一个基于Med-NCA Kalkhof等 (2023)的联邦学习计划. 他们强调FedNCA如何实现与UNets(Ronneberger等,2015年)和TransUNets Chen等(2021年a)相类似的分解精度,但通信成本明显较低.

blocks.en: rNCA is an NCA for repairing segmentations. The model is trained to reverse the corruption of segmentation masks. At inference, the trained model repairs imperfect segmentations ( Silbernagel et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: rNCA是用于修复分块的NCA. 该模型经过了培训,以扭转分化口罩的腐败. 推论,经过培训的模型修复不完善分块(Silbernagel等,2025年)。

blocks.en: Last, Deutges et al. (2025) train an NCA segmentation model from classification labels only. By utilizing the explainability of NCA ( Deutges et al., 2024 ) , the segmentation mask forms in the hidden states of the NCA .
blocks.zh: 最后,Deutges等人(2025年)只从分类标签中培训NCAA分型模型. 通过使用NCAA(Deutges等,2024年)的可解释性,分化口罩在NCAA的隐藏状态下形成.

blocks.en: 4.1.2 Medical Image Registration
blocks.zh: 4.1.2 医疗图像登记

blocks.en:
Registration describes the task of aligning multiple images of different modalities or subjects (patients) into a common coordinate system.
Traditionally, this task is approached by optimizing a linear transform that minimizes an error metric between the fixed and moving image.
Further, keypoint-based approaches allow for the estimation of deformation fields for elastic registration.
However, these approaches are costly and are thus replaced by learning methods.
With Voxelmorph ( Balakrishnan et al., 2019 ) and follow-up work such as Hypermorph ( Hoopes et al., 2021 ) , UNet-based methods were proposed that estimate an elastic deformation field quickly.
Further, TransMorph ( Chen et al., 2022 ) , ViTVNet ( Chen et al., 2021b ) , and NICE-Trans ( Meng et al., 2023 ) were proposed as transformer-based architectures for elastic registration.
blocks.zh:
注册描述了将不同方式或对象(患者)的多幅图像对接到共同坐标系统的任务.
传统上,通过优化线性转换来完成这项任务,将固定图像和移动图像之间的错误度量最小化.
此外,以关键点为基础的方法可以对弹性登记变形地作出估计。
然而,这些方法成本很高,因此被学习方法所取而代之。
与Voxelmorph(Balakrishnan等,2019年)和Hypermorph等后续工作(Hoopes等,2021年)一起,提出了基于UNet的方法,以快速估计弹性变形场.
此外,TransMorph(Chen等,2022年),VitVNet(Chen等,2021年b),和NICE-Trans(Meng等,2023年)被提出作为弹性注册的基于变压器的建筑.

blocks.en:
To the best of our knowledge, the only NCA-based registration approach was proposed by Ranem et al. (2024) .
The authors use a pipeline that is inspired by VoxelMorph ( Balakrishnan et al., 2019 ) , using an NCA for generating a deformation field.
Akin to VoxelMorph, the NCA is trained with a smoothness penalty and a similarity loss.
blocks.zh:
据我们所知,唯一的NCAA注册办法是由Ranem等人(2024年)提出的。
作者使用由VoxelMorph(Balakrishnan等,2019年)所启发的管道,使用NCA来生成变形场.
与VoxelMorph相类似,NCAA以平滑的处罚和类似损失来训练.

blocks.en: 4.1.3 Endoscopic Depth Estimation
blocks.zh: 4.1.3 外观深度估计

blocks.en:
The first work for estimating depth using NCA was proposed by Krumb and Mukhopadhyay (2025) .
The NCA takes a single image from a capsule endoscope and predicts its depth map.
The model itself is small enough to be deployed on an ESP32-S3.
The model is trained using data pseudo-labeled from the foundation depth estimation model Depth Anything V2 ( Yang et al., 2024b ) .
blocks.zh:
Krumb和Mukhopadhyay(2025年)提出了使用NCAA估计深度的第一项工作。
NCAA从一个胶囊内窥镜取出一幅相片并预测出它的深度图.
该型号本身体积小到可以被部署在ESP32-S3上.
该模型使用地基深度估计模型 " 深度Anything V2(Yang等人,2024年b) " 中伪标记的数据进行训练。 。 。 。 。

blocks.en: 4.2 Generation and Synthesis
blocks.zh: 4.2 生成和综合

blocks.en:
Generative models, such as GAN , VAE , or diffusion models, are well-established methods for image generation.
Beyond content generation, these models find various potential applications in visual computing, including image reconstruction, artifact removal ( Fuchs et al., 2024 ) , denoising ( Nazir et al., 2024 ) , or (un-)conditional synthesis ( Kazeminia et al., 2020 ) .
The latter can be utilized to generate additional out-of-distribution samples for training other models ( Du et al., 2021 ) , reduce label imbalance ( Frid-Adar et al., 2018 ) , or to craft new unseen cases for training medical personnel ( Sivakumar et al., 2025 , Frisch et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
GAN,VAE等基因模型,或扩散模型,是图像生成的既定方法.
除了内容生成之外,这些模型还发现了视觉计算中的各种潜在应用,包括图像重建,文物去除(Fuchs等,2024年),去诺化(Nazir等,2024年),或(un-)条件合成(Kazeminia等,2020年).
后者可用于生成额外的分配外样本来培训其他模型(Du等,2021年),减少标签失衡(Frid-Adar等,2018年),或为培训医务人员而设计新的隐形病例(Sivakumar等,2025年;Frisch等,2025年)。

blocks.en: While such generative models are already well-investigated, there are only a few works concerning NCA for image synthesis or enhancement, which we review below.
blocks.zh: 虽然这种基因模型已经得到了很好的调查,但关于NCAA的图像合成或增强,只有几部著作,下文将加以审查。

blocks.en:
Growing images from a seed: Early works, including the initial NCA paper and demo by Mordvintsev et al. (2020) , focus on generating small-scale emoji images.
This method aims to understand biological growth, rather than generating a diverse set of images. The NCA must be retrained for each image, hindering its applications to real-world problems.
Following the work of Randazzo et al. (2021) changes the behavior of a trained NCA using a single symmetric matrix A A , which is multiplied to each state after each NCA step. In the experiments, they managed to reprogram the NCA into removing several parts of the generated lizards’ limbs or changing its color, all while maintaining a mostly stable pattern.
Subsequently, Mordvintsev et al. (2022) and Randazzo et al. (2023) propose NCA architectures that encode isotropic (rotationally equivariant) rules that, hence, can generate the same image in rotated variants. The specific rotation is either determined by placing multiple seeds or inferred randomly due to the stochastic nature of the NCA .
blocks.zh:
从一个种子中生长出图像:早期的作品,包括由Mordvintsev等人(2020年)编写的NCAA初期论文和演示,专注于生成小规模的emoji图像.
这种方法旨在理解生物生长,而不是产生出一套多样的图像. NCAA必须针对每个图像进行再培训,阻碍其应用于现实世界的问题.
在Randazzo等人(2021年)的工作之后,使用单一的对称矩阵A 来改变训练有素的NCAA的行为,在NCAA的每个步骤后被乘以每个州. 在实验中,他们设法将NCAA重新编程为去除生成的蜥蜴四肢的多部分或者改变其颜色,同时保持了大部分稳定的图案.
随后,莫德文采夫等(2022)和兰达佐等. (2023)提出NCAA架构,以编码异构(旋转等效)规则,从而可以在旋转变体中生成相同的图像. 具体的自转方式有的是通过放置多颗种子来确定,有的则由于NCAA的花样性而随机推断.

blocks.en: Growing Graphs: Several NCA have been extended to graphs. Some of which have been evaluated by learning to grow a fixed graph structure ( Dwyer and Omwenga, 2023 , Gala et al., 2023 , Grattarola et al., 2021 ) .
blocks.zh: 增长图:一些NCAA被扩展为图. 其中一些通过学习生长出固定的图表结构得到了评价(Dwyer and Omwenga, 2023年;Gala等, 2023年;Grattarola等, 2021年).

blocks.en:
GAN-NCA-hybrids: The first work that uses NCA in a generative adversarial manner is GANCA ( Otte et al., 2021 ) , which replaces the generator of a vanilla GAN with an NCA model.
The generator is conditioned on the edges of emojis and generates fully colored emojis.
For better performance and training stability, the authors employ modifications akin to the tweaks introduced in WGAN ( WGAN ) ( Arjovsky et al., 2017 ) .
StyleGANCA ( Luu et al., 2026 ) extends the idea with a multi-resolution strategy ( Lemke et al., 2025a ) and style-conditioning ( Karras et al., 2020 ) , resulting in an algorithm for conditional and unconditional medical image generation.
blocks.zh:
GAN-NCA-hybrids: (原始内容存档于2018-09-29). 第一个以基因对抗方式使用NCAA的作品是GANCA(Otte等,2021年),它用NCAA模型来取代香草GAN的生成.
发电机以emojis为条件并生成全色的emojis.
为了更好的性能和培训稳定性,作者采用了类似于WGAN(WGAN)中引入的修饰(Arjosky等,2017年).
样式GANCA (Luu等,2026年)以多解析策略(Lemke等,2025a)和风格-调制(Karras等,2020年)来扩展这个想法,形成了一个有条件和无条件的医疗图像生成算法.

blocks.en:
VAE-NCA-hybrids: Palm et al. (2022) implement an NCA in a variational autoencoder framework.
The encoder is a standard CNN-based variational encoder.
The decoder is a single NCA that is iteratively applied for 8 steps after doubling the resolution using an unpooling operation.
After 5 upscaling operations, the NCA produces the final output image.
Initially, the VAE generates poorly looking images when sampling from the prior.
This issue can be fixed by introducing the beta-VAE ( Higgins et al., 2017 ) loss ( β = 100 \beta=100 ) and averaging multiple decoder runs from the same latent code.
While the generated images look better visually, the averaging removes any detail.
blocks.zh:
VAE-NCA-hybrids: (原始内容存档于2019-09-31). 棕榈等. (2022)在可变自编码器框架中实施NCAA.
编码器是一个基于CNN的标准变异编码器.
解码器是单个NCAA,在使用解码操作将分辨率翻倍后,重复应用到8个步骤.
经过5个升级操作,NCAA生产出最终输出图像.
最初,VAE在取自前作取样时会产生不良的外观图像.
这个问题可以通过引入β-VAE(Higgins等,2017年)损失(β = 100\β=100)来固定,平均多分解码器来自同一种潜伏代码.
虽然生成的图像视觉效果较好,但平均值会删除任何细节.

blocks.en:
Diffusion NCA: By far, most interest in generative modeling with NCA has been in diffusion models, which is probably due to their great success in different fields in recent times ( Dhariwal and Nichol, 2021 ) .
The first published diffusion NCA article ( Elbatel et al., 2024 ) utilizes the ViTCA ( Tesfaldet et al., 2022 ) architecture performing latent diffusion ( Rombach et al., 2022 ) .
The architecture includes adaptive LayerNorm ( Perez et al., 2018 ) inspired by the Diffusion Transformer architecture ( Peebles and Xie, 2023 ) .
FourierDiff-NCA ( Kalkhof et al., 2024a ) relies on the typical fully connected architecture of NCA , but performs diffusion in the Fourier space, which proves to be more efficient than diffusion in the image space directly.
blocks.zh:
分泌NCAA:迄今为止,对NCAA的基因模型化的兴趣多出于扩散模型,这可能是由于它们最近在不同领域取得了巨大成功(Dhariwal and Nichol, 2021).
首次发表的NCAA传播文章(Elbatel等,2024年)利用了VitCA(Tesfaldet等,2022年)架构进行潜在传播(Rombach等,2022年).
该建筑包括了受"分化变形器"(Peebles and Xie, 2023.)所启发而适应的TyleNorm (Perez等, 2018.).
Fourier Diff-NCA (英语). (Kalkhof等,2024a)依赖于典型的NCAA全相通的架构,但在傅里叶空间进行传播,事实证明这种传播比直接在图像空间进行传播更有效.

blocks.en:
Direct synthesis through NCAs: TeNCA ( Lang et al., 2025 ) is a single NCA for generating videos of the temporal dispersion of contrast agent in breast MRI .
The data consists of paired images before and after applying the contrast agent with different delays after the contrast agent was injected.
The authors apply the loss at certain time steps for which a post-contrast image exists.
The trained model can synthesize images, resulting in a video showing the smooth temporal spread of contrast agent in the breast MRI .
blocks.zh:
通过NCAA直接合成:TeNCA(Lang等,2025年)是一款单一NCAA,用于生成乳房核磁共振中对比剂时间分散的视频. .
数据由对比剂被注射后应用有不同延迟的对比剂前后的对映图像组成.
提交人在存在相冲突后图像的某些时间阶段适用损失。
训练有素的模型可以合成图像,产生一段视频,显示对比剂在乳房核磁共振中的平滑时间传播.

blocks.en:
Texture Synthesis: Mordvintsev et al. (2021) are the first to propose the use of NCA for texture synthesis.
They adapt the original NCA training approach ( Mordvintsev et al., 2020 ) by introducing a perception-based texture loss, using a pretrained VGG model to extract high-level appearance features.
Further research on NCA-based texture generation broadly falls into two categories: Methods that explore architectural modifications to improve texture generation abilities, or works that extend NCA-based texture generation to new domains or applications.
We will start by discussing papers that primarily propose architectural modifications: As follow-up work to their original paper ( Mordvintsev et al. (2020) ), ( Mordvintsev and Niklasson, 2021 ) develop μ \mu NCA, a family of texture generation NCAs with as few as 68 total parameters. μ \mu NCA introduces an optimal-transport-based loss function, as well as several modifications to the standard NCA architecture.
To achieve the reduction in model size, μ \mu NCA removes the latent linear layer in the update function and adapts the perception to apply the perception filters to alternating channels, reducing the size of the perception vector. Petersen (2023) propose a variant of the NCA architecture that utilizes multiscale perception. Due to their large memory requirements during training, generating high-resolution textures remains a challenging task. Possible solutions to this problem are developed by Pajouheshgar et al. (2025) and Pajouheshgar et al. (2024b) . Pajouheshgar et al. (2025) propose the use of an NCA operating in a coarse latent space combined with a lightweight decoder network to enable high-resolution texture generation. Pajouheshgar et al. (2024b) demonstrate that using an initial noisy seed instead of stochastic cell-state updates results in more robust behavior with respect to the discretization in both space and time.
This enables upscaling of the perception range of the cell-grid at test-time, resulting in higher resolution textures.
Similarly, the approach of ( Pajouheshgar et al., 2024b ) also gives the user control over the speed at which textures evolve. Catrina et al. (2024) develop an NCA model capable of learning multiple textures by encoding an identifier for the target texture in the initial seed. Training a single NCA on multiple target textures improves parameter efficiency and allows for combining multiple textures in a single cell grid as well as smooth interpolation between textures. Several works aim to extend NCA-based texture generation beyond the setting of static 2D textures. ( Pajouheshgar et al., 2024a ) propose the Mesh Neural Cellular Automata, a variant of the NCA architecture that uses undirected graphs as the state space, allowing for efficient texture synthesis directly on 3D surface meshes.
The authors explore a broad range of applications, including text-guided synthesis, dynamic texture synthesis, and training multiple compatible Mesh- NCA to allow for smooth interpolation between different textures on the same surface mesh. Wang et al. (2025) choose a voxel-based approach to 3D generation.
They introduce the Volumetric Neural Cellular Automata (VNCA), focusing on stylized smoke rendering as an application.
During training, VNCA is conditioned on both a density field and a motion field, allowing it to generalize to new shapes and dynamics at inference time. Pajouheshgar et al. (2023) use NCA to generate dynamic video textures.
To adapt NCA-based texture generation to video, they introduce a novel optical-flow-based motion loss, among other modifications.
Their approach generalizes to videos of arbitrary length and size. Seibert et al. (2024) use NCA to generate realistic surface structures for a wide range of materials.
Their main innovation is the use of statistical descriptors of the surface structure for the loss.
blocks.zh:
纹理合成:莫德文采夫等(2021年)最早提出将NCAA用于纹理合成.
他们通过引入以感知为主的纹理损失,使用经过预先训练的VGG模型来取出高阶外观特征来来调整NCAA最初的训练方法(Mordvintsev等,2020年).
对基于NCA的纹理生成的进一步研究大致分为两类: 探索建筑改造以提高纹理生成能力的方法,或将基于NCA的纹理生成扩展到新的域或应用.
我们首先讨论那些主要提出建筑改造的论文: 作为原作(Mordvintsev等 (2020年))的后续工作, (Mordvintsev和Niklasson, 2021)开发出μ \ mu NCAA,一个纹理生成NCAA的家族,总参数只有68个. μ\mu NCAA引入了以运输为基础的最佳损失功能,以及标准NCAA架构的多处修改.
为了实现模型大小的缩小,μ\mu NCAA去掉了更新函数中潜在的线性层并调整了感知,将感知过滤器应用到交替通道上,减少了感知向量的大小. Petersen (2023)提出了NCAA架构的变体,使用多尺度感知. 由于其在培训期间对内存的大量要求,产生高分辨率的纹理仍然是一个具有挑战性的任务。 Pajouheshgar等人(2025年)和Pajouheshgar等人(2024年b)制定了解决这一问题的可能办法。 Pajouheshgar等人(2025年)提议使用在粗潜空间运行的NCA,并配以轻量级解码器网络来进行高分辨率纹理生成. Pajouheshgar等人(2024年b)证明,使用最初的杂音种子而不是有花样的细胞状态更新,导致在空间和时间的盘状化方面行为更加有力。
这使得在测试时间可以提升细胞网的感知范围,从而产生更高的分辨率纹理.
同样地,(Pajouheshgar等,2024b.)的方法也使用户可以控制纹理进化的速度. Catrina等 (2024)开发出一种NCAA模型,能够通过编码初始种子中目标纹理的标识来学习多纹理. 对单一NCA进行多目标纹理的培训提高了参数效率,使多个纹理在单一细胞网格中结合,并能够平滑地插入纹理. 若干作品旨在将基于NCA的纹理生成扩展到静态2D纹理的设定之外. (Pajouheshgar等,2024a)提出"Mesh神经细胞自发"(Mesh Neural Cellular Automata),是NCA架构的一个变体,它使用未定向图作为状态空间,使得能直接在3D地表膜上进行高效的纹理合成.
作者探索了广泛的应用,包括文本导取合成,动态纹理合成,以及训练多种相容的Mesh-NCA来使不同纹理在同一表面网格上能平滑地插出. Wang等 (2025)选择以活塞为主的方法来进行3D生成.
他们引入了"卷状神经细胞自相机"(VNCA),将分型的烟雾渲染作为应用.
在训练期间,VNCA既以密度场又以运动场为条件,使其能够在推论时间被通向新的形状和动态. Pajouheshgar等 (2023)使用NCAA生成动态视频纹理.
为使以NCAA为主的纹理生成能适应视频,它们引入了新型光学-流取运动损失等修改.
他们的方法概括为任意长度和大小的视频. Seibert等(2024年)使用NCAA来为各种材料生成现实的地表结构.
它们的主要创新是使用地表结构的统计描述符来表示损失.

blocks.en: 4.3 Image Classification
blocks.zh: 4.3 图像分类

blocks.en:
The first paper to use NCA for image classification was a follow-up work to the initial NCA paper by Mordvintsev et al. (2020) , proposing Self-classifying MNIST digits ( Randazzo et al., 2020 ) .
This approach leverages designated output channels to store the final prediction, adding to the hidden channels and fixed input image channel(s).
After running the NCA for 200 time steps, the output channels are populated such that a channel-wise argmax yields the prediction for each image pixel.
In the case of the MNIST dataset, this approach leads to interesting self-organizing behavior, especially in out-of-distribution cases like a chimera of two different digits.
blocks.zh:
最早使用NCAA进行图像分类的论文是Mordvintsev等(2020年)最初NCAA论文的后继工作,提出了自分类的MNIST数字(Randazzo等,2020年).
这种方法利用指定的输出通道来存储最终预测,并加入隐藏通道和固定输入图像通道.
在运行了200个时间步骤的NCAA后,输出通道被集成,这样一个信道的正格马克思就能得出每个图像像素的预测.
在MNIST数据集方面,这种方法导致了有趣的自我组织行为,特别是在分配外的病例中,如由两个不同的位数组成的奇美拉.

blocks.en:
A more recent, practical application in medical imaging is an approach for blood cell classification, which is proposed by Deutges et al. (2024) .
This approach leverages an NCA model that is applied to blood cell images for 64 steps.
Afterwards, the channel-wise maximum is taken to obtain a single low-dimensional latent vector, which is then fed to a 2-layer neural network to obtain a prediction vector.
This idea leverages the hidden channels for the final prediction, instead of appending channels for each category, which would become costly for a multi-class problem.
blocks.zh:
医学成像中较为近期,实用的应用是血细胞分类方法,由Deutges等(2024)所提出.
这种方法利用了适用于血细胞图像的NCAA模型,共64个步骤.
之后,取出通道-最大以获得一个单一的低维潜向量,然后输入到2层神经网络以得到一个预测向量.
这个想法利用了隐藏的渠道进行最终预测,而不是附加每个类别的渠道,这对一个多类问题来说会变得昂贵.

blocks.en: Several works have explored NCA as a robust feature extractor for classification. Ihm et al. (2024) use a pre-trained NCA for robust feature extraction combined with a ResNet for classification. Tesfaldet et al. (2022) pre-train an NCA using a masked autoencoding objective and extract class labels using linear probing.
blocks.zh: 若干作品探索了NCA作为分类的强力特征提取器. Ihm等人(2024年)使用经过预先培训的NCAA来进行强力地物提取并结合ResNet进行分类. Tesfaldet等 (2022) 使用蒙面自编码目标预选NCAA,并使用线性检测提取类标签.

blocks.en: 4.4 Handling Distribution Shifts
blocks.zh: 4.4 处理分配移动

blocks.en:
In medical image analysis, models often encounter distribution shifts, for example, due to changes in the patient demographics or the scanning protocol.
In those cases, we desire mechanisms in the model to automatically deal with those distribution shifts to detect or reject them before giving a misleading prediction. Korevaar et al. (2024) do not propose a methodological contribution, but they investigate the generalization of NCA to OOD ( OOD ) data, which was not seen during training.
They construct a scenario of retinal OCT ( OCT ) images and cardiac MRIs obtained with scanners from different vendors, creating a realistic scenario.
On the retinal data, the NCA outperformed the baseline UNet on ID ( ID ) and OOD data.
On the cardiac MRIs, the NCA performed slightly worse than the UNet on ID data, but significantly better than the UNet on OOD data.
Concluding, the study of Korevaar et al. (2024) suggests that NCA might be better suited for out-of-the-box domain generalization than UNets.
blocks.zh:
在医学图像分析中,模型经常会遇到分布变化,例如由于病人人口统计或扫描协议的变化.
在这些情况下,我们希望模型中的机制能够自动处理这些分配变化,以便在作出误导性预测之前发现或拒绝这些变化。 Korevaar等人(2024年)没有提出方法上的贡献,但他们调查了NCA与OOD(OO)数据的一般化,在培训期间没有看到.
它们构筑了用不同供应商的扫描仪获得的视网膜OCT(OCT)图像和心脏MRI的假想,创造了一种现实的假想.
在视网膜数据方面,NCAA的绩效超过了ID(ID)和OOD数据的基线UNet.
在心脏核磁共振方面,NCA的性能略逊于UNet的ID数据,但明显优于UNet的OD数据.
最后,Korevaar等人(2024年)的研究表明,NCAA可能比UNets更适合在框外域通用.

blocks.en:
While uncertainty estimation and OOD detection are established practices in the analysis of convolutional- and transformer-based models for image segmentation ( Gonzalez et al., 2021 , González et al., 2022 , Lemke et al., 2024 , Fuchs et al., 2022 ) and classification ( Zhang et al., 2021 , Graham et al., 2023 ) , there are only a few works discussing uncertainty estimation of NCA or proposing tailored OOD detection mechanisms.
Generally, NCA have been shown to generalize better to unseen data containing imaging artifacts or acquired at different resolutions.
However, OOD detection is a critical task, especially for medical image analysis ( Yang et al., 2024a ) .
In the following, we present the only two methods for OOD detection during inference time.
To the time of writing, we were not able to find any other works that propose uncertainty estimation or OOD detection techniques for NCA .
blocks.zh:
虽然不确定性估计和OOD检测是分析图像分解的分解和变压器模型的既定做法(Gonzalez等人,2021年;Gonzalez等人,2022年;Lemke等人,2024年;Fuchs等人,2022年);分类(Zhang等人,2021年;Graham等人,2023年;),但只有少数工作讨论NCAA的不确定性估计或提出定制的OOD检测机制。
一般而言,NCAA被证明能更好地概括为包含成像文物或通过不同分辨率获得的隐形数据。
然而,OD检测是一项关键的任务,特别是对医疗图像分析(Yang等,2024a.).
在下文中,我们介绍了推论期间唯一两种测出OD的方法.
在撰写本报告时,我们无法找到任何其他为NCAA提出不确定性估计或OD检测技术的作品。

blocks.en:
NQM: Kalkhof and Mukhopadhyay (2023) propose the NQM to assess prediction uncertainty of NCA .
The non-deterministic inference algorithm produces different segmentation masks for each random seed.
Running the inference multiple times and computing the standard deviation delivers an estimate of the model’s uncertainty.
An uncertainty threshold can successfully detect OOD samples at inference time.
blocks.zh:
NQM: Kalkhof and Mukhopadhyay (2023) 提议NQM来评估NCAA的预测不确定性.
非决定性推论算法为每个随机种子产生不同的分化口罩.
进行多次推论并计算出标准偏差可以提供模型不确定性的估计数.
不确定性阈值可以在推断时间成功检测出OD样本.

blocks.en:
LANCA: Ihm et al. (2024) propose LANCA, a pipeline for training robust, NCA -based feature extractors for image processing.
Using an Autoencoder architecture, LANCA trains an encoder NCA to extract local image features.
Each cell learns to encode its environment in the hidden state, resulting in a fully localized approach to feature extraction.
As demonstrated by Ihm et al. (2024) , a two-stage image classification pipeline consisting of a LANCA encoder and a shallow ResNet displays improved robustness across a wide range of image corruptions compared to a ResNet of equal size without the LANCA encoder.
blocks.zh:
LANCA: Ihm等编. (2024)提议LANCA,一个用于训练坚固,NCA-基于特性的图像处理提取器的管道.
使用Autoencoder架构,LANCA训练出一个编码器NCA来提取本地图像特性.
每个细胞学习在隐藏状态下编码其环境,从而形成一个完全本地化的特征提取方法.
Ihm等人(2024年)表明,由LANCA编码器和浅的ResNet组成的两阶段图像分类管道,比起没有LANCA编码器的同等规模的ResNet,在广泛的图像腐败中表现出了更强的稳健性。

blocks.en: In the following, we will review methods that work on adaptation to the shifted distribution.
blocks.zh: 在下文中,我们将审查在适应变化的分配方面开展工作的方法。

blocks.en:
Leveraging distribution shifts for continual learning: NCAdapt ( Ranem et al., 2025 ) is a continual learning algorithm for NCA based on uncertainty-aware model expansion.
Continual learning deals with shifting distributions by training on a new dataset of the shifted distribution without access to the previous distribution.
During training, the performance on the data of the earlier distributions should be maintained, increasing and expanding the knowledge of the model ( Chen and Liu, 2017 ) .
Unfortunately, continual learning algorithms over-adapt on new data, losing knowledge on solving the earlier tasks, which is known as catastrophic forgetting ( French, 1999 ) .
NCAdapt circumvents this issue for hippocampus segmentation by introducing a few (384) domain-specific parameters into the NCA architecture.
While parameter-expanding continual learning algorithms are nothing novel Rusu et al. (2022) , NCAdapt is probably one of the methods requiring the fewest domain-specific parameters, rendering the model scalable even for large sequences of domain shifts.
The domain-specific parameters are inferred by running multiple inference passes, each of which uses a separate set of domain-specific parameters.
The domain identity is inferred by the minimum NQM ( Kalkhof and Mukhopadhyay, 2023 ) score of each previous run.
blocks.zh:
利用分布变化促进持续学习:NCAdapt(Ranem等,2025年)是NCAA基于不确定性意识-认知模型扩展的一种持续学习算法.
继续学习涉及转移的分布,方法是在无法访问先前的分布的情况下,对转移的分布的新数据集进行培训。
在培训期间,应保持早期分布数据上的性能,增加并扩展模型知识(陈和刘,2017.
遗憾的是,不断学习算法过度适应新数据,丧失了解决早期任务的知识,这被称为灾难性的遗忘(法文,1999年)。
NCAdapt通过在NCAA架构中引入一些(384个)域特有参数来规避这个问题来进行河马分化.
虽然参数扩展持续学习算法并不是新作"Rusu等" (2022),但NCADapt可能是需要最少的域特有参数的方法之一,使得模型甚至对于域相变的大序列来说都具有可扩展性.
域特有参数通过运行多段推论传出来推断出,每一段都使用一组单独的域特有参数.
域名由上回各跑道的最低NQM分(Kalkhof和Mukhopadhyay,2023年)来推断出.

blocks.en:
Unsupervised Fine-tuning: If, after a data shift, new images are recorded but not annotated, one has to use an unsupervised algorithm to adapt to the new distribution. Kalkhof et al. (2024b) propose an algorithm for unsupervised fine-tuning for NCA , so the model will adapt to the new distribution without requiring any labels of the novel data.
The method makes use of the NQM ( Kalkhof and Mukhopadhyay, 2023 ) metric that measures the quality of the prediction based on the output variance of multiple NCA runs.
By reducing the standard deviation and improving the NQM , the model will automatically adapt to the new distribution in an unsupervised manner.
blocks.zh:
无监督 微调 : 如果在数据转移后,新图像被记录下来但没有附加注释,人们必须使用一个不受监督的算法来适应新的分布. Kalkhof等 (2024b)为NCAA提出了无监督的微调算法,因此该模型将适应新的分布而无需对新数据作任何标记.
该方法使用NQM(Kalkhof和Mukhopadhyay,2023年)的度量衡,根据多次NCAA运行的输出差异来测量预测的质量.
通过降低标准偏差并改进NQM,该模型将以不受监督的方式自动适应新的分布.

blocks.en: 4.5 Data Compression
blocks.zh: 4.5 国家 数据压缩

blocks.en:
With the ongoing digitization of the healthcare sector, the demand for medical data records on disk space has become a challenge.
In 2013, roughly 153 Exabytes of medical data were produced.
It was projected that in 2020, 2314 Exabytes of medical data would be produced, which corresponds to a yearly growth of 48 % 48\% ( Stanford Medicine, 2017 ) . Choi et al. (2023) report detailed information of the picture archiving and communication systems storage requirements at the Seoul National University Hospital from 2015 to 2022.
They estimated a yearly growth of 11.25 % 11.25\% , reaching up to 3000 TB 3000\text{\,}\mathrm{TB} of data in 2029.
Such enormous data generation puts high storage demands on clinics, which are typically not well-equipped.
To alleviate the space requirements, compression schemes for medical image data have already been discussed ( Tong et al., 2025 , Xin and Fan, 2021 ) .
The same issues appear in remote sensing with satellites and drones taking high-resolution scans of the Earth. NASA reports to have more than 128 PB 128\text{\,}\mathrm{PB} of storage with a daily growth of 147 TB 147\text{\,}\mathrm{TB} ( Earth Science Data Systems, 2024 ) .
A similar issue arises from genomic sequencing data. The genome of a single human can reach up to 100 GB 100\text{\,}\mathrm{GB} of data. Greenfield et al. (2019) expect the data demand for genome sequences to reach 40 EB 40\text{\,}\mathrm{EB} per year by 2025.
blocks.zh:
随着卫生部门的数字化,对磁盘空间医疗数据记录的需求已成为一项挑战。
2013年,大约产生了153个医疗数据。
据预测,2020年,将编制2314份医疗数据,年增长率为48%。 (斯坦福医学, 2017). 崔等编. (2023年)报告2015至2022年首尔国立大学医院图片存档和通信系统存储要求的详细信息.
他们估计年增长率为11.25%,
这种庞大的数据生成对诊所提出了很高的存储需求,这些诊所通常设备不完善。
为了缓解空间要求,已经讨论了医疗图像数据的压缩计划(Tong等,2025年;Xin和Fan,2021年)。
同样的问题出现在遥感中,卫星和无人机对地球进行了高分辨率扫描。 美国国家航空航天局报告说,储存量超过128个PB 128\text ~,}\ mathrm{PB},每天增长147个TB 147\text ~,}\ mathrm{TB}(地球科学数据系统,2024年).
基因组测序数据也有类似问题。 单个人类的基因组最多可达到100GB 100\text\,QQ mathrm{GB}的数据. Greenfield等 (2019)预计到2025年,对基因组序列的数据需求会达到每年40 EB 40\text~,}\-mathrm{EB}.

blocks.en:
Falcao et al. (2025) propose to use NCA for natural image compression.
The method splits the image into smaller patches and trains a separate growing NCA ( Mordvintsev et al., 2020 ) for each patch.
The parameters of each NCA can be represented more efficiently than the pixels
themselves.
Although this is so far the only work investigating image compression with NCA , with an increase in other neural methods for data compression, we believe that this so far under-explored area could soon gain more traction.
blocks.zh:
Falcao等 (2025)提议使用NCAA进行自然图像压缩.
该方法将图像分出为更小的补丁并训练出一个单独的生长NCAA(Mordvintsev等,2020.
每个NCAA的参数可以比像素更高效地表示
他们自己。
虽然这是目前为止调查NCAA图像压缩的唯一工作, 随着数据压缩的其他神经学方法的增加,我们认为,这个迄今探索不足的区域很快会获得更多的牵引力.

blocks.en: 4.6 Simulation
blocks.zh: 4.6 模拟

blocks.en:
CA have long been used to model spatio-temporal processes governed by local interactions.
Since PDE can, in principle, be reformulated as CA ( Yang and Young, 2010 ) , NCA naturally extend this approach to learn such dynamics directly from data. Li and Yeh (2001) , Li and Yeh (2002a) , Yeh and Li (2003) , Okwuashi et al. (2012) train a neural network that encodes the update algorithm for a single CA step.
Consequently, NCA have been applied to urban development, land-use transitions, microstructure evolution, atmospheric dispersion, and biological pattern formation.
Because the training is non-iterative, their formulation does not fit our NCA definition; regardless, we have decided to include them in this work due to the large community behind it.
blocks.zh:
长期以来,CA被用于模型化由本地交互控制的斯皮提奥-时态过程.
由于PDE原则上可以被重新命名为CA (Yang and Young, 2010),NCAA自然会将这种方法扩展为直接从数据中学习这种动态. 李同叶(2001年),李同叶(2002年a),叶同叶(2003年),奥克武阿希等(2012年) 训练神经网络,为单CA步骤编码更新算法.
因此,NCA应用于城市发展、土地使用过渡、微观结构演变、大气分散和生物形态形成。
由于培训是非强制性的,培训的制定不符合我们国家竞争主管机构的定义;不管怎样,我们决定把培训纳入这项工作,因为培训背后的社区很大。

blocks.en:
Urban development and land-use simulation: Urban development and land-use change are spatial processes emerging from local transitions such as densification or infrastructure expansion.
Modeling these dynamics requires combining neighborhood interactions with contextual features.
